boundary.startingEvent: The hero applies a stethoscope and answers the direction prompt with an adjacent square: js/cmd.js dispatches `a` to doapply(), which reaches use_stethoscope() past confdir().
boundary.endingEvent: The top line C prints for that square, and the turn the listen does or does not spend. For an empty square that is "You hear nothing special." at apply.c:468; for a monster it is mstatusline()'s status line; for a mimic it is "That chest is really a small mimic." and then the status line.
boundary.validInputs: Any of the eight directions, plus the hero's own square. A Healer starts with an uncursed stethoscope at u_init.c:79, so no wizard mode and no wish are needed to reach the boundary.
boundary.observables: The top line and its --More-- redraws; the status line mstatusline() writes; gb.bhitpos and gn.notonhead; the free-versus-costly listen alternation already held in state.context.stethoscope_seq; and the vision map writes seemimic() and map_invisible() make. The arm consumes no randomness.
boundary.exclusions: Everything above confdir() at apply.c:379, which the port already refuses: a steed, an engulfer, a nonzero u.dz, and a cursed stethoscope. Below it: its_dead()'s statue arm, use_stethoscope()'s SDOOR and SCORR arms, and mstatusline()'s long-worm, u.ustuck and u.usteed arms, each of which needs setup no ported command reaches.

sourceReview: apply.c use_stethoscope() (317-470) and its_dead() (196-309) were read in full at 073cd13 against nethack-c/upstream, and every branch between confdir() at 379 and the return at 469 is entered above. Random-number order is unaffected: no arm inside the boundary draws, which is why the goal forecasts 33 screens and no change in the random-number total. Helpers were checked for existing ports one by one, and the four checks recorded in javascriptCrossCheck were run rather than assumed. Two limits stand: its_dead()'s corpse arm and mstatusline()'s info fragments are traced only to the depth that places them in later slices, and both are named in remainingLimits. Re-read at 9657e3b for slice 1: apply.c its_dead() (196-309) and use_stethoscope() (384-470) line by line, invent.c nxtobj() (1477-1491), trap.c uteetering_at_seen_pit() (6647-6653) and cmd.c:3346 sdir[]. The ported frame draws no random number, which both fresh differentials confirm: 1,813 and 2,701 calls, matching C exactly.
